title: What is a Graph Quiz
description: A quick check to review graph basics.

questions.questionText: What are the two main parts of a graph?
questions.explanation: A graph is made of nodes, also called vertices, and edges, which are connections between nodes.

questions.questionText: Which example is commonly modeled as a graph?

options.text: A road map with cities and roads

questions.explanation: A road map can be modeled as a graph where cities are nodes and roads are edges.
